unresolved_sources: The September Bulgarian chat mentions June EPAM and S&P conversations. Those older originals were not retrieved; their assistant-described contents are not treated as independently verified sources.
content_review_required: Correct Recall@k versus Hit@k in old chat/card answers.
Qualify GIL claims by interpreter/build; do not describe async as releasing a GIL per coroutine.
Do not claim every tuple is hashable; elements matter.
Do not claim yield creates concurrency or guarantees bounded pipeline memory.
Check context-manager cleanup semantics rather than promising cleanup after process termination.
Clarify softmax produces next-token probabilities, not necessarily whole-word probabilities.
Avoid treating vector search and SQL as mutually exclusive.
Validate all option sets before app import; no historical answer is accepted automatically.
